stance: Consumer sentiment is mixed. UMich-type readings stay weak (48.0 in October, near the May 2026 low of 44.8; 5y inflation expectations 3.5%, a minor hawkish signal). Conference Board rebounded to 91.7 from 84.2 (unconfirmed, single source), with Expectations 72.6 below 80 and a labour differential of 5.3 that points to stable jobs. Divergence between surveys, so low conviction. Cautious, neutral-to-bearish lean on consumer. Firm retail sales, a second CB gain or Expectations above 80 would lift the view; 5y expectations above 3.5% would add a hawkish tilt.
